smallest_supported_claim: In this source-matched native run, the player established R032 Assignment Camp at absolute OMT [162,36,0], then used its native assignment UI to assign the same nearby follower character:25. Native NPC inspection afterward showed CAMP_RESIDENT and assigned_camp [162,36,0], and ordinary camp work/job-priority controls remained accessible. Native save/quit and OS process exit completed; persistence and post-reload work remain pending.
causal_account: The disposable fixture supplied one unassigned follower only as setup. Native World/chat and dialogue owners offered the camp route; the native camp-type menu offered the bare-bones recipe. After the resulting camp appeared in the authoritative current-site camp observation, the native TALK_CAMP assignment route opened the camp assignment UI, where character:25 was the listed worker. The same live character ID then inspected as CAMP_RESIDENT with assigned_camp matching the camp OMT. A normal camp mission-selector route reopened job priorities and exposed sorting out the loot at priority 1. The process then followed native Save and Quit and main-menu quit confirmations and exited with code 0. This segment does not yet prove the persisted state or ordinary work controls after process replacement.

citations.meaning: Initial native inspection identifies the setup follower and confirms no prior assigned camp.
After native camp creation, the current-site basecamp record identifies the new camp, owner, and OMT.
The native assignment UI lists one worker for the new camp at the matching OMT and faction.
Independent native inspection confirms the same follower became a resident assigned to the camp OMT.
The native worker priority menu accepted and displayed an ordinary job priority of 1.
The normal camp mission selector exposed job assignment and ordinary looting/sorting controls.
Opening job priorities from the normal camp board retains the same single worker and camp.
The player invoked the currently advertised native world Save and Quit action.
The player invoked the main-menu Quit action after returning from Save and Quit.
The owned game process exited through its native quit route.
